source_text: Nordic medical and ethical bodies, influenced by advocacy for genital autonomy, have pushed for restrictions or bans on non-therapeutic circumcision, as seen in Denmark's 2016 recommendation by the Danish Medical Association to end the practice for boys under 18, framing it as a personal choice deferred to maturity due to pain, rights infringements, and questionable necessity. [85]
